text:
maya-peopleops: Heads-up: bulk-invite job for next week's onsites failed for ~18 candidates. Seeing timezone mapping errors in the ATS webhook.

nick-recruiter: I noticed several invites never went out and some that did had no scorecard link. Candidates pinging us.

azra-scheduler: job id job-2026-04-20-9:14 failed with 422 from ATS: 

```
POST /webhooks/ats/invite
response: 422
body: {"error":"Invalid timezone 'IST' for candidate 8fd3b"}
```

azra-scheduler: our scheduler normalizes tz to abbreviations for legacy reasons; ATS expects IANA names (e.g., Asia/Kolkata).

sam-eng: thanks. that's the mismatch. We introduced abbreviation normalization in 2024 to make compact payloads, but it's brittle. I can patch scheduler to send IANA names and add a server-side whitelist mapping as a fallback.

maya-peopleops: ETA? we need invites out by EOD today or we'll be manually scheduling.

sam-eng: I can ship a hotfix to translate common abbreviations (IST, PST, CET) to IANA in 2-3 hours and enable retries for failed invites. I'll add a feature flag so we can rollback.

nick-recruiter: will you also include missing scorecard url in the invite payload? That explains the blank link in emails.

sam-eng: yes — two issues: (1) timezone causing 422 so ATS rejects the invite, (2) our invite template didn't include scorecard_url for panel-level templates when created via bulk job. I'll fix both: add scorecard_url and validate payload before sending.

ats-bot: note: recent change 1973452000 added abbreviation normalization to scheduler. Might be related.

maya-peopleops: For now, can we run a targeted resend after patch only for job-2026-04-20-9:14?

sam-eng: yep I'll add a "resend_job" path that replays the validated payloads and marks successes.

azra-scheduler: temporary manual workaround: I'll export affected candidate list and send calendar invites with a short note and link to scorecard. But will wait for the hotfix if it's <3h.

nick-recruiter: I'll prepare the candidate-facing message and interviewer heads-up once we confirm resend. Keep me posted.

sam-eng: posting PR in ~90m. Telemetry: adding event invite.bulk_failure with reason,tz,job_id so we can surface recurring bad abbreviations.

maya-peopleops: thanks team. After PR, please drop the banner copy for interviewers and I'll coordinate the manual emails if needed.
